## The task

The box starts at rest on the floor and must end fully on the platform, at
rest. The disk alone cannot carry it. The **indirect lift** tips the box onto
the step corner, lets the disk walk round to the box's raised underside,
lifts the box off the floor and rolls it onto the platform, the box held at
every instant:

{g} → {m<sub>x</sub>, g} → {m<sub>x</sub>, g, s} ⇒ {m<sub>x</sub>,
g<sub>v</sub>, s<sub>v</sub>} → {g<sub>v</sub>, s<sub>v</sub>} →
{m<sub>z</sub>, g<sub>v</sub>, s<sub>v</sub>} → {m<sub>z</sub>,
s<sub>v</sub>} → {m<sub>z</sub>, t} → (transport) goal.

## The planner finds it from the scene alone

The search is given the scene and the goal, nothing else: every edit the gate
admits except releases, transports toward the gate's targets, and outcome
children (a call's child is the state it reached). Every dynamic outcome is
rejected, so every solve is **held**. The motions are the quasi-static
realizer Λ<sub>qs</sub> in MuJoCo. The test set is held out: the canonical
start (the disk 10 cm from the box) and 16 random lift starts (F1 seed 11,
never used for training), at the band's two ends μ = 0.3 and 0.5: 34
searches, each up to 192 calls.

| Ordering | μ = 0.3 | μ = 0.5 | All | Calls to solve (mean) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| V₀ (hand-built value) + uniform ranker | 9 / 17 | 8 / 17 | **17 / 34** (50%) | 154 |
| V₁ + learned ranker π, round 0 | 11 / 17 | 12 / 17 | **23 / 34** (68%) | 142 |
| V₁ + learned ranker π, round 1 | 13 / 17 | 13 / 17 | **26 / 34** (76%) | 89 |

Every solve is the indirect lift (one holds the box by its lower corner
instead of its underside). After round 1 the learned pair solves every
instance V₀ solves and 9 more (exact McNemar p = 0.004), and where both solve
it needs half the calls (77 against 154, fewer in all 17). Of the 8 searches
it does not solve, 7 run out of actions to try under every ordering (6 of
them within 17–56 calls): a limit of which actions exist, not of their order. With 64 calls neither solves any of the 18 it was run on:
the search reaches {m<sub>z</sub>, s<sub>v</sub>} with the box at 51–57°,
where the roll is not held throughout and Λ<sub>qs</sub> refuses it; the
longer searches find how to tilt the box further first (a re-grip: break
m<sub>z</sub> to 63°, make m<sub>z</sub>).

With V₀'s edge lengths measured from the search's own calls (a transfer
succeeds 46% of the time, a break 69%) instead of equal, the hand-built
ordering solves the same 17 searches, and the round-1 V₁ and π, not
retrained, solve **28 of 34** (14 / 17 at each μ; two more than with equal
lengths, none fewer).

**V₀** is the weighted graph distance to the goal plus a pose term
([how it is built](../planar-build/search.qmd#v0)), here built for the
current gate with every edit weighted equally. **V₁ and π** are learned by
fitted value iteration and the LTS loss from unhinted searches on other
starts (F1 seeds 20–22, never the test set). Round 0 learns from 80 searches
of 64 calls, none of which reached the goal (it learns from the states they
did reach); round 1 adds 48 searches of 192 calls run with round 0's V₁ and
π, 32 of which reached the goal. V₁ enters only the search's order;
acceptance stays with V₀.

<video src="media/unhinted/v1it1_mu0.3_canon.mp4" controls muted playsinline preload="metadata" width="100%"></video>

**The canonical start, μ = 0.3, round 1**: 12 calls on the path, 94 in the
search; the replay reproduces all 12.

<video src="media/unhinted/unhinted_mu0.3_s11_12.mp4" controls muted playsinline preload="metadata" width="100%"></video>

**μ = 0.3, V₀**, 11 calls on the path (150 in the search): the pivot, a push to
20°, break m<sub>x</sub> to 51°, make m<sub>z</sub>; the re-grip to 63°;
break g<sub>v</sub>, the roll onto the platform, two pushes. The replay
reproduces all 11 calls.

<video src="media/unhinted/unhinted_mu0.5_s11_10.mp4" controls muted playsinline preload="metadata" width="100%"></video>

**μ = 0.5, V₀**, 10 calls on the path (163 in the search). The replay
reproduces 8 of 10 calls exactly; two end 2.6 mm off (the search ran on
another machine; float32 differs slightly between processors).

## With the formation sequence given

Given the indirect lift's sequence as a hint (at a node in the chain's k-th
formation only edits into the (k+1)-th and transports), the same planner with
the V₀ above solves at μ = 0.5 (15 calls, 12 on the path) and exhausts its
search at μ = 0.3 and 0.4: the branch that would succeed depends on where a
push ends to within a degree (break m<sub>x</sub> from 43.1° succeeds, from
43.8° it does not), and the hint leaves no other way. With V₀'s edge lengths
measured from the unhinted search's own calls (a transfer succeeds 46% of the
time, a break 69%), the hinted search solves at μ = 0.3, 0.4 and 0.5 (15, 13
and 15 calls), on the routes of the paper.

<video src="media/indirect/hinted_v0it0_mu0.5.mp4" controls muted playsinline preload="metadata" width="100%"></video>

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## How to read a clip

- **View.** From the side, with +x to the **left**, as in the paper. The
  green surface is the platform, the grey one the floor, the blue ball the
  disk. A red stripe marks the face the box rests on at the start.
- **Top-left box.** The run; the current segment *k/n* with its edit and
  formations (σ → σ′); the formation the recognizer reads right now; and
  whether the replay matched the log.
- **Speed.** Stated in the overlay. Λ<sub>qs</sub> calls are mostly at rest,
  so they play at 3× while the box rests and in real time while it moves.
- **Cards.** A short hold after each segment, then the success test's verdict.
:::

## What this shows, and what it does not

- **The lift, found and held, at both ends of the friction band**, from the
  scene and the goal alone, on starts the learned parts never saw.
- **One scene, one task.** The step and the box; other scenes (the families)
  are not run.
- **Budget.** Half the searches fail within 192 calls with V₀, a quarter
  after two rounds of V₁ and π; most failures run out of actions to try.
- **The realizer.** Λ<sub>qs</sub> plans held poses, not stick–slip plans
  ([the local solver](../planar-build/local-solver.qmd#qs-slip)).

## Configuration and reproduction

Branch `phase1/planar`, commit `19bd7a9` (a call Λ<sub>qs</sub> refuses after
its approach returns the approach's motion, so a box that falls during it is
seen as dynamic). V₀: `cmg/scripts/step4/value/results/v0_it0`. Results,
models and summaries: `cmg/scripts/step4/chain_search/results/night_2026-11-13`.
Searches run on CPU, one per 3 cores; a search needs about 80–90 thousand
memory mappings, so they do not run on the clusters (65,530 per process).

```text
CMG_DISK_FRICTION=0.3 CMG_MAPGUARD=0 JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu PYTHONPATH=src .venv314/bin/python \
    scripts/step4/chain_search/run_chain.py OUT --no-hint --dynamic-outcomes reject --budget 192 \
    --v0 scripts/step4/value/results/v0_it0/v0_it0.json --seed 11 --index 12
#   add --v1 MODEL --learned-pi MODEL for the learned ordering
#   (MODEL: scripts/step4/chain_search/results/night_2026-11-13/model_v1pi)
```
